description:
Manage Focus time-off with the following actions:

- **approve-timeoff-entry** (data: entry_id*)
- **archive-timeoff-category** (data: category_id*)
- **cancel-timeoff-entry** (data: entry_id*)
- **create-timeoff-balance-adjustment** (data: payload*{amount*, time_off_category_id*, user_id*, date, note})
- **create-timeoff-category** (data: payload*{allow_negative_balance*, auto_approve_under_days*, default_amount_per_year*, description*, emoji*, max_carry_over_amount*, name*, prorate*, accrual_frequency, allowance_type, carry_over_expiry_months, policy_link})
- **create-timeoff-for-user** (data: payload*, user_id*)
- **delete-timeoff-category** (data: category_id*)
- **delete-timeoff-for-user** (data: payload*, user_id*)
- **get-timeoff-absence-report** (data: category_id, end_date*, include_pending, start_date*, team_id, user_id)
- **get-timeoff-balance-changes-for-user** (data: category_id*, page, rows, user_id*, year)
- **get-timeoff-balances** (data: category_id, date, user_id)
- **get-timeoff-balances-for-user** (data: category_id, date, user_id*)
- **get-timeoff-categories** (data: none)
- **get-timeoff-category** (data: category_id*)
- **get-timeoff-entries** (data: category_id, from, page, rows, status, team_id, to, user_id)
- **get-timeoff-entry** (data: entry_id*)
- **get-timeoff-for-user** (data: from*, to*, user_id*)
- **get-timeoff-timeline** (data: category_id, from, status, team_id, to, user_id)
- **get-timeoff-whos-out** (data: end_date*, start_date*)
- **get-timeoffs-by-user-ids** (data: end_date*, start_date*, user_id*)
- **import-timeoff-balances** (data: payload*{category_id*, rows*})
- **reject-timeoff-entry** (data: entry_id*, payload*{reason*})
- **restore-timeoff-category** (data: category_id*)
- **update-timeoff-category** (data: category_id*, payload*{allow_negative_balance*, auto_approve_under_days*, default_amount_per_year*, description*, emoji*, max_carry_over_amount*, name*, prorate*, carry_over_expiry_months, policy_link})
- **update-timeoff-for-user** (data: payload*, user_id*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.
